title: Elon Musk blames Indian 'oligarchs' for stalling Starlink launch
summary_full: Space X founder Elon Musk accused oligarchs in India of keeping Starlink out of the country to protect their monopoly over consumers.
summary_public: Space X founder Elon Musk accused oligarchs in India of keeping Starlink out of the country to protect their monopoly over consumers.
